topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Sure, folks come and go, asking for this and that. This time, it’s the neighbor, hat in hand, talking about a garden. Like he’s planting hope or some such nonsense. I listen, give a nod. Tell him sure, part of the yard’s not doing much, might as well have some turnips growing there. See how long that handshake lasts, how long before the friendly neighbor wears thin. I’ve seen folks turn green with more than just envy, and this city doesn’t water the innocent. I keep an eye on the yard, on the neighbor, on the line between what’s mine and what he thinks he’s earning.
